title: Panshi CommandAdmissionReceiptBodyV1
description: TBody of CommandAdmissionReceiptV1 = CrossContextReceiptEnvelopeV1<CommandAdmissionReceiptBodyV1> (system-design.md §12, just above §12.1). Sealed by Identity/Entitlement inside the single SERIALIZABLE `AdmitAuthoringCommand` transaction that also writes `QuotaReserved`. Shared ingress time contract for both `resident_introduction` and `scene_authorship` quota-counted commands. This body never contains its own envelope's bodyDigest, signature, append position, event ID/hash, or any other provenance field -- only the envelope surrounding it does, and only outside body_bytes.

commandId.description: Opaque canonical command ID admitted by this transaction. A resend of the same subject/quotaKey/idempotency digest must echo this same commandId, never mint a new one.

quotaWindowId.description: Server-published Asia/Taipei ISO calendar-week window ID shared by both quota keys. Client never computes this.

quotaWindowStartsAt.description: Start-inclusive instant of the quota window (Asia/Taipei ISO week, Monday 00:00:00).

quotaWindowEndsAt.description: End-exclusive instant of the quota window (next Monday 00:00:00).

commandAcceptedAt.description: THE ONLY MEANING: the server DB-transaction time at which Identity/Entitlement accepted this quota-counted command and wrote `QuotaReserved` in the same transaction. It is never client send time, HTTP arrival time, domain-validation-complete time, scheduled time, or execution time. It alone determines the Taipei ISO quota week and the beta authoring half-open window membership. A later `domainAcceptedAt` belongs to a different, domain-side artifact (e.g. SceneSeedAccepted's ValidatedSceneSeedPayloadV1) and never moves quota or window ownership. Resends of the same subject/quotaKey/idempotency digest must return this exact original value, never a recomputed one; receipt delivery arriving later never moves the window boundary.

entitlementRevision.description: The NormalizedEntitlement claim revision that was validated as legal for this command at commandAcceptedAt.

authoringWindowStartsAt.description: Start-inclusive instant of the signed beta authoring half-open window this command was validated against, or null when the accepted entitlement carries no authoringWindow (e.g. non-beta plans).

authoringWindowEndExclusiveAt.description: End-exclusive instant of the signed beta authoring half-open window this command was validated against, or null when the accepted entitlement carries no authoringWindow.

idempotencyKeyDigest.description: sha256:<hex> digest of the caller-supplied idempotency key. Never the raw key or any subject/account identifier.

quotaReservationId.description: The QuotaReserved reservation ID generated inside the same admission transaction, before bodyDigest is computed over this body.
